## Interpretación geométrica

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5

# Datos
x <- seq(0, 12, length = 600)
fx <- dgamma(x, shape = 3, scale = 1.5)

# Esperanza
mu_val <- 3 * 1.5

# Márgenes más limpios
par(
  mar = c(4.5, 4.5, 3, 1),
  family = "sans"
)

# Gráfico base
plot(
  x, fx,
  type = "n",
  ylim = c(0, max(fx) * 1.15),
  xlab = "x",
  ylab = "f(x)",
  main = "Centro de masa de una distribución Gamma(3, 1.5)",
  cex.main = 1.4,
  cex.lab = 1.2,
  cex.axis = 1.05
)

# Cuadrícula suave
grid(
  nx = NULL, ny = NULL,
  col = "gray90",
  lty = 1
)

# Área bajo la curva
polygon(
  c(0, x, max(x)),
  c(0, fx, 0),
  col = adjustcolor("#93c5fd", alpha.f = 0.55),
  border = NA
)

# Curva Gamma
lines(
  x, fx,
  lwd = 4,
  col = "#1e3a8a"
)

# Línea de la esperanza
abline(
  v = mu_val,
  col = "#991b1b",
  lwd = 3,
  lty = 2
)

# Punto en la media
points(
  mu_val,
  dgamma(mu_val, shape = 3, scale = 1.5),
  pch = 19,
  cex = 1.5,
  col = "#991b1b"
)

# Etiqueta elegante
text(
  mu_val + 0.5,
  max(fx) * 0.82,
  labels = expression(E(X) == 4.5),
  col = "#991b1b",
  cex = 1.25,
  font = 2
)

# Caja alrededor del gráfico
box(col = "gray40")
```
